rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=300, recon_eta=60.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=True, recon_dcstep_every=3, recon_dcstep_n_cg=20, recon_dcstep_warmup=25, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=6, train_n=0, seed=42, rationale=iter-11 FINER-SAMPLING: recon_sample_steps 200->300 at the eta=60/every=3/n_cg=20 peak. eta plateaued (60=0.8452, 90 overshot 0.840), DC frequency exhausted (every=8 dropped to 0.835), and n_cg 10->20 was flat (0.8459) - the hard-DC inner solve was already converged, so measurement-consistency is NOT the limiter. The untouched axis is DDIM trajectory fidelity: at 200 steps the DPS+hard-DC reverse path is discretization-limited (iter-2 already showed 100->200 helped). Hyp: 300 steps lowers per-step DDIM error so the prior + periodic hard-DC projection settle onto a more data-consistent recon, lifting SSIM above the 0.845 eta/DC plateau. val_n trimmed 20->6 to keep wall <=15 min at 1.5x heavier sampling (iter-10 at steps=200/18-scenes hit the 1800s sample cap).
